hero.title: Four solutions. One partner network.
hero.subtitle: We bring contact center and telecom technology to the partners serving Mexico, Central America, the Caribbean and Colombia.

about.title: We are a distributor, not another reseller.
about.lead: A 100% Mexican company founded in 2018. We distribute communications and AI-as-a-service technology, and we work exclusively through partners: our business is making theirs work.
about.body: We never compete with our partners for the end account. We provide the catalog, the training, the technical presales and the support a partner needs to sell and deploy — without carrying the infrastructure or managing a direct relationship with every vendor.
about.mission: To be the distributor that grows its partners: bringing them dependable contact center and telecom technology, and standing with them through the sale, the deployment and the support.
about.vision: To build the strongest distribution ecosystem in the region: trained partners, first-tier vendors, and customers who evolve without friction.

solutions.title: What we distribute
solutions.lead: Four lines that sell on their own or together, depending on what each partner already serves.

ccaas.name: CCaaS
ccaas.summary: Cloud contact center: omnichannel, intelligent routing and analytics, with no infrastructure of your own.
ccaas.detail: Contact center platforms operated as a service. The partner sells the whole solution — voice, digital, reporting and AI-assisted agents — without standing up or maintaining a single server.

sbc-telecom-data.name: SBCs and telecom data analysis
sbc-telecom-data.full: Session Border Controllers and traffic analytics
sbc-telecom-data.summary: Secure and normalize SIP traffic, and turn CDR into decisions.
sbc-telecom-data.detail: Session Border Controllers to protect the network edge, normalize signaling between carriers and resolve interoperability. On top, the analytics layer that turns call detail into insight on usage, quality and fraud.

messaging.name: Messaging and digital channels
messaging.summary: WhatsApp, SMS, RCS and social in the same service flow as voice.
messaging.detail: Digital channels wired into the contact center, not parked in a separate inbox. Includes transactional messaging, campaigns, and the APIs to connect them to the CRM the customer already runs.

sip.name: SIP telephony
sip.summary: Regional coverage, portability and quality measured end to end.
sip.detail: SIP trunks and numbering with regional coverage, portability and quality monitoring. The foundation the contact center and the digital channels rest on.

presence.title: Where we operate

privacy.title: Privacy notice
privacy.lead: How we collect, use, share and protect your personal information.
privacy.intro: At Expertise Tech and Training we are committed to protecting your privacy and the security of the information you provide when using our services. This Privacy Policy describes how we collect, use, share and protect your personal information.

collect.title: Information we collect
collect.body: We collect personal information that you provide directly when using our services, such as your name, email address, telephone number, and other information necessary to carry out our business operations.

use.title: Use of information
use.body: We use the information collected to provide, maintain and improve our services, as well as to comply with our legal obligations. This includes, among other things, personalising the user experience, communicating with you about our products and services, and preventing fraudulent activity.

share.title: Sharing information
share.body: We do not sell or share your personal information with unaffiliated third parties, except in limited situations where it is necessary to provide services or to comply with legal obligations. We ensure that any third party with access to your information meets appropriate privacy and security standards.

chat.title: Chat assistant
chat.body: This site offers an assistant that answers questions about our services. Conversations are processed through an artificial intelligence provider and are retained for a maximum of 90 days, for the sole purpose of improving the content of the site and the quality of its answers. We do not request personal data through the chat: if you wish to share it, we direct you to our contact form. We recommend that you do not enter sensitive information in the chat.

security.title: Information security
security.body: We implement technical and administrative security measures to protect your information against unauthorised access, disclosure, alteration and destruction.

rights.title: Access to and control of your information
rights.body: You have the right to access, correct and delete your personal information. You may exercise these rights by contacting us through the channels provided at the end of this notice.

changes.title: Changes to the privacy policy
changes.body: We reserve the right to modify this Privacy Policy at any time. Any change will take effect immediately after the updated version is published on our website. We recommend reviewing this Policy periodically to stay aware of any changes.

contact.title: Contact
contact.body: If you have questions or concerns about this Privacy Policy, or if you wish to exercise your privacy rights, you may contact us by email:

privacy.acceptance: By using our services, you accept the terms of this Privacy Policy.
